checkpoint_selection: v4 B_best from protocol014 provenance; historical seeds use reassessed per-epoch weights
normalization: checkpoint training statistics; real native capacities supplied equally; reference evaluations use original capacities

dynamic.remove: zero actual activations in complete recording window
dynamic.add: any unmatched input before fallback; at most one
dynamic.new_key: normalized mean of latest at most 256 unmatched routing states; separate RNG on zero mean

development.selection: per method equal-pair mean second-half F1; smaller LR on ties

confirmation.acceptance: D mean second-half pooled-host F1 >= 0.65 and greater than B; equal weight for all 15 pairs

rolling.no_anomaly: null F1 with false positives and support disclosed

stop_and_report: pilot or development does not show approved advantage
any proposed simulator, pressure, drift or method change
ordinary_degradation: hypothesis to observe; never a manufactured or guaranteed result
